# Pi Token Plan Monitor

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![Pi Package](https://img.shields.io/badge/pi-package-blue)](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-coding-agent)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](./LICENSE)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor)

![preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor/main/docs/preview.png)

Pi extension that displays API balance or Token Plan subscription quota in the status bar.

Balance display supports:

- DeepSeek Platform

Token Plan subscription supports:

- OpenCode Go
- Qwen Token Plan Personal Edition (China)

## Install

```bash
pi install npm:@yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor
```

Restart pi or run `/reload` to activate.

## Usage

### DeepSeek

Balance appears automatically when a DeepSeek model is selected. No configuration needed.

### OpenCode Go

Usage appears automatically when an OpenCode Go model is selected.

### Qwen Token Plan Personal Edition (China)

Run the setup command:

```
/token-plan-setup-qwen-cn
```

Follow the prompts to enter your browser cookie.

### Other

To add support for additional providers, implement the `UsageProvider` interface in `src/providers/` and register it in `src/index.ts`.

# Pi Token Plan Monitor

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

[![Pi Package](https://img.shields.io/badge/pi-package-blue)](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-coding-agent)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](./LICENSE)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor)

![preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor/main/docs/preview.png)

Pi 扩展，在状态栏显示 API 余额或 Token Plan 订阅额度。

余额显示支持：

- DeepSeek Platform

Token Plan 订阅支持：

- OpenCode Go
- 千问 Token Plan 个人版（中国版）

## 安装

```bash
pi install npm:@yoyoyoake/pi-token-plan-monitor
```

重启 pi 或执行 `/reload` 生效。

## 使用

### DeepSeek

选择 DeepSeek 提供商模型后自动显示余额，无需配置。

### OpenCode Go

选择 OpenCode Go 模型后自动显示用量，无需配置。

### 千问 Token Plan 个人版（中国版）

在 Pi 中使用命令：

```
/token-plan-setup-qwen-cn
```

按提示输入浏览器 Cookie。

### 其他

若需要添加其他 Provider，在 `src/providers/` 中实现 `UsageProvider` 接口并在 `src/index.ts` 中注册。
